notes.title: Journey of Resurgence June 27, 2025 Update
notes.content:
A small update has been rolled out with the following improvements and additions:

[list]
[*]Added right-click functionality to the character status panel for easier equipping/unequipping of gear and using items.
[*]Updated questline: new quests added for finding the blacksmith and the Gobuji.
[*]Village building states are now visible directly from the world map, and players can also enter village interiors directly from the map.
[*]Optimized enemy spawning logic — enemies now spawn more reasonably near the player.
[*]Added a combat entrance animation for the Gobuji. When joining the battle during preparation, Gobuji will now make a cool entrance.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence June 13, 2025 Update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Optimized operations in the equipment panel: you can now right-click to equip or unequip gear, synthesize advanced armor shards, and use food.
[*]Updated the item drop system: players can now obtain materials and armor shards more easily.
[*]When the mouse hovers over an item for a certain period of time, the tooltip will lock in place, making it easier to read the item information.
[/olist]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence June 11, 2025 Update
notes.content:
This update fixes the issue where the equipment repair kit could not be used, and increases the number of repair kits rewarded from quests (from 1 to 10)

To enhance gameplay, we’ve added merchants with different functions across the map. They have distinctive icons above their heads — go talk to them!

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence June 10, 2025 Update
notes.content: We discovered that after the tutorial, Kaen didn't actually leave the party. Now, he has truly left us — even though he didn’t want to either.

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence June 9, 2025 Update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Improved the questline; the new storyline will guide players to explore the map.
[*]Corrected translation errors in the game.
[*]Fixed known bugs in the game.
[/olist]

notes.title: An Announcement About Zeir！！ He’s not insane—he’s just more lucid than you.
notes.content: [h3]🎭 [b]Who is he?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Zeir.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Calls himself a “Life Consultant”![/p][/*][*][p]In reality? He’s a wandering merchant dealing in biological modifications.[/p][/*][*][p]He doesn’t just sell parts—he sells a deep, personal doubt about your entire design.[/p][/*][/list][p]His bag talks. notes.title: Journey of Resurgence April 30, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Here are the additions in this update:

Gameplay Updates:

[list]
[*]Fallen units will no longer appear in the party; if the entire player party is defeated, it now results in game over.
[*]Players can now flee from battle, but doing so will cost gold and a portion of HP. If gold is insufficient, more HP will be lost.
[*]Villages now allow players to store resources and gold.
[*]Stamina regeneration during battle has been removed. Players can now recover both HP and stamina by gathering and consuming food.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where character portraits displayed inconsistently in the party status screen between the world map and team management scenes.
[*]Fixed an issue where buildings in the player's camp could not be constructed or upgraded.
[*]Fixed abnormal tooltip display in some UI elements.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence April 14, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Today's update mainly fixes issues left over from last week's update:

[olist]
[*]Fixed an occasional issue in the tutorial that could cause the progression to be interrupted.
[*]Optimized the battle interface operation UI.
[*]Improved the map UI.
[/olist]
Our programmers apologize for the impact caused to all adventurers!

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence April 11, 2025 Update
notes.content:
This update brings the following changes to the game:

[list]
[*]Fixed display issues in the Talent UI.
[*]Improved the skill selection UI in the battle interface.
[*]Optimized patrol display logic, making it easier to distinguish enemies on the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence April 7, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Here are the changes in this update:

[list]
[*]Optimized the opening animation and camp transition effects.
[*]Improved the camp resource UI tutorial; yellow highlight boxes are now replaced with a breathing effect.
[*]Fixed an issue where all initial NPCs in the tutorial were incorrectly equipped with spears.
[*]Fixed an issue where the hit rate of allied characters in the tutorial dropped to 0.
[*]Fixed an issue from the last update where the Zerg boss in the tutorial stopped attacking.
[*]Optimized the battle interface: battle info boxes now retract when a dialogue box appears.
[*]Optimized the tracking UI under characters’ feet, leaving only the pointer to indicate their position.
[*]Fixed an issue where the world map interface couldn't be closed using hotkeys after being opened with them.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence April 3, 2025 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where tooltip display was abnormal at high resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: 《Journey-of-Resurgence》Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]April Update Preview[/b][/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]1: Ecological Renewal[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Natural Ecosystem Enhancement: Enriched vegetation and shrubs. Different terrains will feature plant communities at varying growth stages.
[*]Camp Atmosphere Upgrade: Player and NPC camps will now include fences, scattered material piles, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318669/2c58fa08607ae76f679322ad72eb80bde43c5cf4.png[/img][hr][/hr]
[*] Player Camp Revamp: The invisible walls around player camps will be replaced with fences, allowing multi-directional access to camp interiors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318669/0ea18dcf1d8639f530644828e3a5860bb7770174.png[/img][hr][/hr]
[*] First Exploration Ceremony: Trigger a unique cinematic scene when entering any faction’s territory for the first time.
[/list]
[h3][b]2: Strategic Enhancements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Favorability System: Donate resources or complete tasks for NPCs to boost faction favorability, unlocking hidden trade options or discounts. Angering a faction lowers favorability and may provoke retaliation!
[/list]
[h3][b]3: English Version Progress[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization Efforts: To welcome global adventurers to Rejuvenation Journey, the English version is underway! Vegetation names, material descriptions, and camp guides on the world map have been reworked for English contexts.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Expanded Map Plans[/b][/h2]
🌳 Chapter II: Broadleaf Forest · Wheat Fields · Wasteland
🍄 Chapter III: Mushroom Forest · Thorny Bramble
(Future updates may hide interactive surprises within certain plants…)

[h2][b]New Characters[/b][/h2]
Preview of select upcoming characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318669/73073500decf8baed1a2b8b3cb44b7a792e89b9b.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Current Development Progress[/b][/h2]
✅ Completed: Shrub/fence collision testing, optimized fence-building physics.
🛠 Finalizing: Faction cinematic storyboarding, English UI adaptation.
📆 Major Update Release: Late April
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Player Interaction[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]  Join our community! The dev team will dive into discussions in late April to collaborate on designing the next ecological zone.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
“This world refuses to stand still—every revival marks the beginning of a new cycle.”
—Journey-of-Resurgence Dev Team

notes.content:
This week, we have updated the following:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where dialogue backgrounds would unexpectedly disappear.
[*]Optimized the backpack UI: item quantity and durability are now clearly visible.
[*]Improved enemy behavior logic on the map: enemies now walk more intelligently.

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence March 21, 2025 Update
notes.content:
After two weeks of work, we have updated the game with the following improvements:

[list]
[*]Improved the display of skill and character information during battles, making it easier to observe changes on the battlefield.
[*]Enhanced the item information display in the inventory.
[*]Tracy and Clyde's black market is now open! It is located in the northwest of the World Tree on the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence March 6, 2025 Update
notes.content:
The following updates have been made:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue with abnormal save file loading
[*] The opening logo of the game can now be skipped (press ESC to skip)
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence March 4, 2025 Update
notes.content:
This update mainly optimizes the task-related display:

[list]
[*] Clear prompts are now shown when accepting, completing, or changing the status of a task.
[*] Dialogs that appear during tasks can now properly hide other UI components.
[/list]

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence February 28, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Today we have updated the following content:

[list]
[*] Tasks after the prologue can now be completed normally.
[/list]
Wishing all players a happy weekend!

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence February 26, 2025 Update
notes.content:
In the past few days, we have made the following updates:

[list]
[*] Optimized the skill bar display effect
[*] The status of combat units can now be displayed correctly
[*] Fixed the issue where the battle loot item images were displayed incorrectly
[*] Fixed the issue where using shortcut keys to select a skill would freeze when using the shortcut to select a target
[*] Fixed the issue where enemies occasionally stopped acting during battle
[/list]

Thank you all for your attention to our game. Next, we will focus on improving the game’s quests, while continuing to optimize performance and enrich the game content.

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence February 24, 2025 Update
notes.content:
After a day's work, the programmer has fixed the following issues:

[list]
[*]Added task tracking feature
[*]Fixed the issue where map exploration progress wasn't saved
[*]Fixed the issue where shortcut keys failed when returning to the main menu and entering the game
[*]Fixed the issue where the task skill selection box disappeared after using a skill
[*]Fixed the issue where save files couldn't be deleted
[/list]
We are working hard to improve the game content. Thank you to all the players for your valuable feedback!

notes.title: Journey of Resurgence Launches on Steam Early Access February 24th!
notes.content:
Indie studio Stellar Realms Network proudly announces that its open-world adventure Journey of Resurgence will debut on Steam Early Access starting [b]February 24, 2025.[/b] From launch day through [b]March 10, 23:59[/b] (UTC+8), players can purchase the game at [b]10% off[/b] the full price to experience its evolving development build and participate in shaping its universe.

From humble beginnings as a three-person team to our current ten-member family, we—ten passionate individuals from diverse backgrounds—have spent 270 sleepless nights translating our imagined world into code and pixels. With no prior game development experience, we've stumbled through this journey like explorers crossing a river by feeling the stones beneath our feet. Countless times, solving one issue would unexpectedly reveal another issue.

We fully acknowledge that the current build may still suffer from performance stutters, clipping glitches, and other imperfections. Yet the harsh reality is: we must survive to improve. Launching now feels like throwing a clumsy yet fervent embrace towards the stars—it's imperfect, but represents every ounce of sincerity we can muster at this stage.

Every Steam review, social media suggestion, and player's wild idea tagged @us could redefine this world's destiny. If you encounter bizarre bugs during your adventure, please accept our deepest apologies. We implore you to share feedback via social media platforms or service Email. Every piece of input is a treasure, we'll rigorously analyze to deliver meaningful improvements.

This Early Access release isn't a half-baked compromise—it's an invitation to kindle a bonfire of creativity alongside fellow travelers. May these flickering flames light our shared path through the long night ahead.

With utmost gratitude,
The Stellar Realms Network Team
